content:
Let the central angle of the shaded sector be \(\theta\).

The upper semicircle has total angle \(180^\circ\), so
\[
\theta+40^\circ+35^\circ+30^\circ+20^\circ=180^\circ.
\]
Thus
\[
\theta=180^\circ-125^\circ=55^\circ.
\]

A sector’s area is the same fraction of the whole disk as its central angle is of \(360^\circ\). Therefore the probability is
\[
\frac{55}{360}=\frac{11}{72}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{11}{72}}
\]
